user.title: Add a feed
user.description: Enter the name and the URL of the RSS or Atom feed to follow. The feed is fetched once to check that it can be read.

data_description.feed_url: Address of the feed (http, https or file).
data_description.date_format: strftime format used for the dates of the entries.
data_description.local_time: Convert the dates of the entries to the time zone of Home Assistant.
data_description.scan_interval: Time between two refreshes of the feed. At least one minute.
data_description.show_topn: Only the most recent entries of the feed are kept.
data_description.remove_summary_image: Strip the img tags from the summary of the entries.
data_description.inclusions: Keep only these fields of each entry. Leave empty to keep all of them. Add `image` to get the URL of the first image.
data_description.exclusions: Remove these fields from each entry.
data_description.user_agent: Value of the User-Agent header sent to the server. Some servers block or stall unknown clients.

error.cannot_connect: The feed could not be fetched. Check the address and try again.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with http://, https:// or file://.
error.scan_interval_too_short: The refresh interval must be at least one minute.
